alt: A row of histogram bar heights with a final bar of height 0, next to a stack of bar numbers whose heights rise from bottom to top. When a bar is not taller than the top of the stack, the top bar is popped and its widest rectangle is measured from the bar below it on the stack to the current bar. The largest rectangle seen is the answer.
